mapper.select:
select a.module_id as moduleId, a.id as serviceId, a.service_code as serviceCode, td.datasource_id as dataSourceId, s.code as dataSourceCode, b.module_type as moduleType, b.module_bean as moduleBean, b.module_method as moduleMethod, b.api_type as apiType, b.api_url as apiUrl, t.id moduleTableId from cfg_module_api a left join cfg_module_info b on a.module_id = b.id and b.deleted=0 left join cfg_table_definition td on b.main_table_id = td.id and td.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN cfg_module_table t ON b.id=t.module_id and b.main_table_id = t.table_id AND t.is_main = 1 AND t.deleted = 0 left join infra_data_source_config s on td.datasource_id = s.id and t.deleted=0 where a.deleted=0
and a.module_id = #{moduleId}

select a.id as serviceId, td.datasource_id as dataSourceId from cfg_module_api a left join cfg_module_info b on a.module_id = b.id and b.deleted=0 left join cfg_module_info bb on bb.id = b.mapping_module_id and bb.deleted=0 left join cfg_table_definition td on bb.main_table_id = td.id and td.deleted=0 where a.deleted=0 and a.service_code = 'MAPPING_GET_BY_ID'
and a.module_id = #{moduleId}
